note: Private chefs and chef-at-home services for this city only. Facts come from each chef’s own website (see sources); prices and group sizes as published there on the date checked. Photos only from the chef’s own website, credited; no photo = monogram.

chefs.name: Nalou Dining
chefs.description: Chef Nathan Campbell (Hotelschool Ter Duinen, then Michelin-starred kitchens) builds a seasonal menu from scratch for your table. He brings the ingredients, tableware and service, and leaves the kitchen clean.
chefs.serves: Ghent, East Flanders and the rest of Flanders

chefs.name: 50 Fifty
chefs.description: The kitchen of 50 Fifty comes to your home with its 'Chef's Choice': a multi-course menu cooked in your kitchen, in a fish-and-meat or a vegetarian version.
chefs.serves: Ghent and around (€10 travel fee within 30 km)

image.alt: Glazed aubergine with pomegranate and fennel (50 Fifty)

chefs.name: Food@Home Culinair
chefs.description: Chef Henk Janssens cooks and serves a menu in your own kitchen, for parties at home in and around Ghent.

chefs.name: What The Food
chefs.description: Plant-based private catering and private-chef dinners by Margaux, based in Ghent’s Zuid district.

image.alt: A colourful plant-based bowl (What The Food)

chefs.name: Bien Cuit
chefs.style: Fine dining, sharing, Italian, modern European
chefs.description: Chef Pieter Uytterlinde plans the menu with you, shops, cooks on site and cleans up: 4- or 5-course fine dining, a sharing concept, seasonal Italian or modern European, with fish or vegetarian options.
chefs.serves: Ghent is one of his regular service areas

image.alt: A plated starter in a white bowl (Bien Cuit)
